title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta16

## Work mode persistence field test

Beta15 changed Work mode cloud persistence but field testing on H215 still showed
the selected value returning to the previous mode after roughly 20-60 seconds.

Beta16 changes only the remaining device-side encoding variable:

- Standard: mower `2`, cloud `2`
- Efficient: mower `3`, cloud `3`
- Precision: mower `4`, cloud `4`

This is deliberately not model-specific. `mode` remains the reported Work mode
field, and `lawnMowingEfficiency` remains a separate observed vendor field.

## Device-command outcome diagnostics

Settings writes that use the immediate mower command now keep a privacy-safe
trace of the corresponding `/vehicle/set/response` lookup.

Diagnostics record only:

- whether a mower command was used;
- whether a command number was returned;
- whether a response was received;
- response type/top-level key names;
- small status-like scalar fields when present.

The raw command response and command number are not exported.

This lets the next field test distinguish an accepted cloud write from a mower
command that was ignored, rejected or never produced a usable result.

## Per-setting persistence verification

Beta15 used one shared delayed-readback task. A later setting write could cancel
the earlier setting's verification and replace its diagnostics.

Beta16 keys both command-status and persistence tasks by setting. Each setting
now keeps its own:

- requested value type;
- short readback at about 15 seconds;
- persistence readback at about 75 seconds;
- mower-command outcome summary.

Changing another setting no longer cancels or overwrites the Work mode trace.

No Map Card update is required.
